name: postcombat_main_raid_creature_cast_after_attacking
note: CR 505.1, 302.1: a creature spell can be cast in either main phase of its controller's turn, so a Raid creature can be cast after the attack it rewards. P0 attacks with a Bear, then in the second main phase casts Goblin Boarders ('Raid — This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if you attacked this turn'): the printed 3/2 enters with the counter, a 4/3. Red on main d0200d2: the cast raised 'illegal cast: window:phase', sorcery speed meant the first main phase only (B-74), and every Raid card was dead. Twin: postcombat_main_raid_creature_cast_without_attacking.
